hypotheses.reasoning: ingest-api heap usage keeps climbing (78%, then 87%) and old gen is not reclaimed after full GC, which points to an eventCache leak. That ends in OutOfMemoryError at eventCache.put and OOMKills of the pods, one after another. While pods restart, the gateway has no healthy upstream and returns bursts of 502s. I searched ingest-api logs for a version or release line and found none, so this doesn't look like a deploy. The single DLQ message in event-processor is an isolated red herring.
The cache leak could have come from a recent code change, but no deploy line was found.

verdict.recommendedAction: Raise the ingest-api memory limit or roll pods to stop the bleeding. Then fix the unbounded eventCache in ingest-api (add a size limit and eviction) and take a heap dump to confirm the leak.
